🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Küche (In the kitchen)

der Herd = stove
der Teller = plate
die Tasse = cup
das Glas = glass
der Löffel = spoon
die Gabel = fork

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
